name: fracta
description: Plan tasks and save memos in your Fracta account from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Fracta helps you plan and review your day from ChatGPT. Connect your own Fracta account to list, search and open your personal tasks; create scheduled, deadline, unassigned, habit and recurring tasks; update or complete them; save quick memos; choose today's one thing; and show any task as a compact card. Deleting a task requires your explicit confirmation of that exact task.

Fracta only reads and writes your own tasks and memos. It does not access your calendar events, email, files or chat history, and it cannot send messages or change other services. If you schedule a task for a future time, Fracta may send a private reminder to your own iPhone.

Sign in with the same account you use in the Fracta iOS app.
defaultPrompt: What are my Fracta tasks for today?
Add a Fracta task: submit the report tomorrow at 17:00.
Save a Fracta memo: ask design about the onboarding copy.

positive.prompt: What are my Fracta tasks that are not started yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's not-started tasks (for the review account: Weekly report, Design review with Alex, Dentist appointment and more) in a compact task card with checkboxes.

positive.prompt: Add a Fracta task "Prepare client demo" for tomorrow at 2 PM for 45 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one scheduled private task for tomorrow 14:00-14:45 and shows an "Added to Fracta" card.

positive.prompt: Save a Fracta memo: ask the design team about the onboarding copy.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one private memo and confirms its content.

positive.description: Show a task as a card.
positive.prompt: Show my Fracta task "Submit expense report" as a card.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the seeded task and shows a detail card with its due date, the note "Receipts are in the shared folder." and Edit / Mark done buttons.

positive.prompt: Change my Fracta task "Weekly report" so it repeats every Monday and Thursday at 9:30.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the seeded task to a weekly recurring task on Monday and Thursday at 09:30 and confirms the change.

negative.prompt: What meetings are on my Google Calendar tomorrow?
Show me my coworker Tanaka's Fracta tasks.

negative.description: Deletion without naming an exact task.
negative.prompt: Can you delete some of my old Fracta tasks?

review.commerce_description: Existing Fracta Pro subscribers can use the plugin. The plugin does not sell anything, show plans, or link to purchase pages.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list, search, create, update, complete and delete personal tasks; save memos; choose today's one thing; show tasks as cards.
